name: L0 exclusion removal
description: 移除 L0 exclusion constraint，仅保留 max_2bit=8，验证 solver 自动发现 L0 sensitivity
analysis:
Reviewer 视角：结果 trivially correct，不构成任何贡献。在重构后的论文中仅作为 §3 methodology 的一句话验证（"We verify that the sensitivity-based allocator automatically assigns higher bit-widths to the most sensitive heads without manual exclusion rules"），不列为 finding。


Solver 确实自动将 L0 heads 分配到 8-bit——但 reviewer 将此解读为 "profiler works as expected, this is not a finding"。R2 评论："Of course a sensitivity-based allocator assigns high bits to the most sensitive heads. This is the expected behavior of ANY profiling-based method, not a contribution." R3 补充："This just shows the profiler is not broken — it would be alarming if it DIDN'T assign 8-bit to L0." 在 worst 档下，这个实验从 "solver discovers structure" 的正面叙事 变成 "trivially expected behavior" 的无贡献证据。新 framing 下降级为 methodology validation footnote。

name: Llama-3.1-8B full pipeline
description: 在 Llama-3.1-8B (GQA 4:1) 上复制完整 pipeline，测试跨架构泛化
analysis:
在 worst framing 下，Llama 的 negative result 强化 reviewer 论点：per-head allocation 对大多数 架构无价值。但在重构后的 "systematic study" framing 下，Llama 是 boundary condition case (concentration=0.57, just above 0.50 threshold, but t₁/t₅=0.85 violates second criterion)， 证明 diagnostic 的 joint condition 比单一 threshold 更准确。


MCKP 仅比 uniform 好 0.02 PPL——reviewer 认为这在 calibration noise 范围内（multi-seed std=0.065 on Qwen，Llama 的 0.02 差距更小）。R1："A 0.2% improvement is statistically indistinguishable from noise without multi-seed confidence intervals on Llama." R2 将 1.07× unconstrained degradation 定性为噪声："1.07× could easily be explained by evaluation variance — you need to show this is significantly different from 1.0." 在 worst 档下，Llama 成为 "non-uniform allocation is pointless on this architecture" 的直接证据，而 reviewer 进一步推论："If profiling + MCKP + constraint adds complexity for zero benefit on 7/8 models, the method has negative expected value." 新 framing 下 Llama 是 "when it doesn't help" 的 case study，支撑 systematic coverage 贡献。

name: Mistral-7B-v0.3 full pipeline
description: 在 Mistral-7B-v0.3 上复制完整 pipeline
analysis:
Mistral 是 reviewer 攻击 universality claim 的最强武器。Monotonic k-PPL 证明没有任何 k 值能 让 non-uniform 优于 uniform。在重构论文中，Mistral 与 Gemma-2 一起构成 "Flat distribution: skip profiling" 的 taxonomy 类别。


MCKP 比 uniform 4-bit 差 0.034 PPL——non-uniform allocation 在 Mistral 上 actively harmful。 R3 引用此结果："Your method HURTS performance on Mistral. The profiler reports near-zero sensitivity differences, meaning your entire profiling pipeline produces zero signal on this architecture. This is not 'honest negative result' — it's evidence the method doesn't generalize." k ablation 单调递增进一步证实：每增加一个 2-bit head 都损害质量，最优 k=0 即 uniform 4-bit。Reviewer 将 1.08× unconstrained 归为 noise，与 Llama 1.07× 一起构成 "mild cases are noise" 的论据。新 framing 下 Mistral 是 "profiler zero-signal" 的典型 case，支撑 "when to skip profiling" 的 diagnostic 贡献。

name: Compounding effect sweep
description: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上 sweep max_2bit 从 0 到 112，绘制 compounding threshold
analysis:
跨架构 compounding sweep 结果实际上 undermines universality：Qwen U-shape (k*=8)，Llama flat-then-cliff (k*=0 即 uniform)，Mistral monotonic (k*=0)。Reviewer 论证：compounding behavior 是架构特异性的，不存在 universal threshold。新 framing 下这成为 taxonomy 的支撑 ——不同 distribution shape 对应不同 compounding pattern。


Reviewer 承认 PPL 随 k 增加而上升，但拒绝将此称为 "discovery"。R1 引用 RateQuant Appendix M： "Zhang et al. (2024) explicitly discuss that quantization errors compound when multiple heads are simultaneously quantized to low bit-widths. Your sweep merely quantifies a known phenomenon." R2 补充："This is the expected behavior of any lossy compression — more aggressive compression leads to more degradation. The curve shape is unsurprising." R3 指出 U-shape 仅在 Qwen 上出现："Llama shows flat, Mistral shows monotonic increase. The U-shape is a Qwen-specific artifact, not a universal phenomenon." 在 worst 档下，compounding sweep 从 "principled motivation for constraint" 降级为 "expected compression behavior on one model"。 新 framing 下放入 §4 "Analysis of allocation failures" 作为 supporting evidence。

name: Budget sweep
description: 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上测试 2×/4×/8× 压缩比下的 constrained MCKP
analysis:
Budget sweep 在新 framing 下成为 "compression ratio analysis" section 的核心——展示 benefit 何时出现、何时消失。但 reviewer 拒绝将 aggressive compression 结果计入贡献 （trivially expected），将 moderate compression 限定为 n=1 evidence。


R2："The benefit at 2× compression is marginal (3.4%), and 8× compression is unrealistic for deployment — nobody runs 2-bit KV cache in production. The only interesting data point is 4× where you get 29% on ONE model. This is a single-model, single-compression-ratio result dressed up as a general finding." R1 补充："At aggressive compression, ANY non-uniform scheme will beat uniform 2-bit — this is trivially true and not a contribution. The interesting regime is moderate compression where your method fails on 7/8 models." 在 worst 档下，budget sweep 被 reviewer 框定为：mild compression → trivial gain， moderate compression → works on 1/8 only，aggressive compression → trivially expected。

name: High-resolution profiling
description: 64seq × 2048tok hires profiling on Qwen2.5-7B，测试更精细 profiling 是否改善分配
analysis:
新 framing 下 profiling resolution 成为 "practitioner guide" 的一部分：低分辨率已足够 判断是否值得 non-uniform (diagnostic)，高分辨率仅在确认 Spread 模型后才值得投入。 但 reviewer 质疑任何 profiling 的 ROI。


Hires 确实改善了 0.32 PPL（11.23→10.91），但 R3 攻击 profiling cost："65 minutes of GPU time for 0.32 PPL improvement on a 7B model — at this cost, you could simply run the model in fp16. The profiling overhead negates any memory savings for realistic deployment scenarios." R1 指出 hires 仅改变了 8/112 heads 的分配："The low-resolution profile already gets the constraint right (k=8). The hires improvement is marginal fine-tuning within the feasible set, not a qualitative change." 在 worst 档下，hires profiling 被视为 diminishing returns 的证据——大部分 benefit 来自 constraint（lowres constrained 已优于 uniform）， profiling resolution 是次要因素。

name: C4 cross-dataset evaluation
description: 用 C4 数据集评估 Qwen2.5-7B，验证结果非 WikiText-2 特异性
analysis:
Cross-dataset robustness 在新 framing 下是 "benchmark methodology" 贡献的一部分。但 reviewer 认为 96.4% agreement 是 trivially expected，不构成 finding。Llama/Mistral 的 cross-dataset negative results 实际上支撑 "most models don't need profiling" narrative。


R2："Cross-dataset agreement of 96.4% is expected — head sensitivity is a model property, not a data property. This is a sanity check, not a contribution." R1 关注 cross-domain degradation："When calibrating on WikiText-2 and evaluating on C4, MCKP PPL is 20.56 vs uniform 35.42 — but both are terrible compared to bf16 baseline of 15.32. The 'benefit' is relative to an already-bad uniform baseline, not absolute quality." R3："You only test cross-dataset on Qwen, the one model where your method works. Show me cross-dataset results on Llama and Mistral where the method already fails — does it fail worse?" 实际上 Llama/Mistral cross-dataset 也已测试且确认 negative，但 reviewer 将此视为方法无价值的 更多证据。

name: RateQuant greedy comparison
description: 实现 RateQuant Algorithm 1 在 {2,4,8,16} 上，展示 greedy 在非连续 bit-width 上失败
analysis:
这是 worst 档下最致命的 reviewer objection 之一。RateQuant comparison 需要在论文中 明确 acknowledge：我们不是说 RateQuant 错了，而是说 hardware-aligned bit-width 引入了 RateQuant 未考虑的 failure mode。新 framing 下降级为 "related work comparison" 而非 核心贡献。


R1 (最致命攻击)："RateQuant's greedy is designed for consecutive integers {2,...,6} where Prop. 6 guarantees optimality. You're evaluating it on {2,4,8,16} which violates its assumptions — OF COURSE it fails. This is like criticizing a sorting algorithm for not doing matrix multiplication. RateQuant never claimed to work on non-consecutive sets." R2："Both unconstrained solvers fail (greedy 32.45, MCKP 36.92) — this just confirms that the problem is with unconstrained allocation on {2,4,8,16}, which is a known limitation of hardware-aligned bit-widths, not a novel finding." R3："Your 'contribution' is adding a single integer parameter k to cap 2-bit heads. This is standard regularization, not a research contribution." 在 worst 档下，RateQuant comparison 被完全 invalidated：不公平的 comparison + trivial fix = no contribution。

name: Oracle comparison
description: Brute-force oracle 在 Qwen2.5-7B 子集上，量化 MCKP 与 oracle 的 gap
analysis:
Oracle gap 微小 (0.005 PPL) 在 worst framing 下被解读为 "constrained problem is trivially easy"——任何 solver 都能解决。新 framing 下移入 appendix 作为 methodology validation。


R3："MCKP is near-optimal — but this is EXPECTED given that the cardinality constraint reduces the feasible set to where any reasonable solver works. You showed greedy=MCKP already (plan_016). The oracle comparison just confirms the problem is trivially small under the constraint. This reinforces my view that the constraint is doing all the work, and the solver (including your MCKP formulation) is a non-contribution." R2："If the average gap is 0.005 PPL, the solver doesn't matter. You've proven your own contribution irrelevant." 在 worst 档下，oracle comparison 是 double-edged：证明 MCKP near-optimal BUT ALSO 证明问题在 constraint 下退化到 trivial。

name: Cross-domain calibration robustness
description: C4 calibration → WikiText-2 评估（及反向），报告 per-head allocation agreement
analysis:
Sanity check 级别。在重构论文中仅作为 methodology paragraph 的一句验证，不单列。


R2："96.4% agreement is a trivial finding. Head sensitivity is a function of model weights, not calibration data — any reasonable calibration set will produce similar profiles. This is a methodology sanity check that belongs in the appendix, not a contribution." 在 worst 档下， cross-domain robustness 完全不计入贡献。新 framing 下放入 §3 methodology 的 1-2 句话。

name: Head sensitivity visualization
description: 生成 paper-quality figures: per-head delta heatmap, compounding curve, allocation chart
analysis:
Reviewer 要求更多可视化来支撑 "systematic study" framing。当前 3 张图不够，需扩展到 ~8 张以覆盖所有架构的对比分析。


Visualization 本身不被 reviewer 攻击，但 R1 指出："Your heatmap shows that Layer 0 dominance is the only interesting signal in Qwen's sensitivity profile. This is a single architectural quirk, not a generalizable finding. Show me heatmaps for ALL 8 architectures side by side — that would be a systematic study." 在 worst 档下，可视化 demand 大幅增加：需要 8 个架构的 对比 heatmap + 3 个架构的 compounding curve + taxonomy 分类图。新 framing 下 visualization 是 "systematic benchmark" 贡献的核心展示方式。

name: Downstream task evaluation (Qwen)
analysis:
跨架构 downstream 数据在 worst 档下是最致命的攻击面。ARC-Challenge 系统性退化 (-3.24pp Yi, -2.65pp Llama, -1.19pp Mistral) 被 reviewer 解读为 "multi-step reasoning tasks are hurt by non-uniform allocation"。新 framing 必须诚实报告这些 negative 结果 并将其作为 "when not to use non-uniform" 的核心 evidence。


R2："Downstream results confirm that your method works on Qwen — we already knew that from PPL. The question is whether it works on OTHER models, and your own downstream results show it HURTS: Yi -0.77pp, Llama -0.99pp, Mistral -0.48pp. Your method has negative expected value across the tested model population." R3："72.8% recovery sounds good until you realize it's 72.8% of the gap between uniform 4-bit and bf16 — on a single model. ARC-C shows only +3.16pp which is within single-seed variance range. You provide no confidence intervals for downstream metrics." R1 最尖锐："4/4 non-Qwen models show downstream degradation. The paper should be titled 'Non-Uniform KV Cache Quantization Hurts Most Models' Downstream, with Qwen as the Exception.'" 在 worst 档下，downstream eval 成为方法 negative expected value 的 证据。

name: 70B profiling-only
description: Qwen2.5-72B profiling only (no full eval)，测试 sensitivity pattern 是否跨 scale
analysis:
Killed 状态在 worst 档下被 reviewer 视为论文的重大 gap。"All results are on 7-14B models — no evidence the method or findings transfer to production-scale models." 新 framing 必须 在 limitations 明确讨论 scalability。


R1："You claim universality but cannot even run your method on 70B models. The profiling pipeline is too expensive for realistic model sizes. This fundamentally undermines the practical contribution — practitioners work with 70B+ models, not 7B." R3："Scalability is the elephant in the room. 65 minutes profiling for 7B × 112 heads — extrapolating to 72B × 1024+ heads means 10+ hours of GPU time, which is unacceptable." 在 worst 档下， 70B killed 成为 scalability failure 的直接证据。新 framing 需要 acknowledge scalability limitation explicitly 并提出 efficient profiling 作为 future work。

name: K/V separation
description: K/V heads 独立 MCKP allocation vs joint K+V
analysis:
Negative result。在新 framing 下报告为 "K/V separation does not improve allocation under our framework"——honest negative finding 支撑 systematic study 的 credibility。


R1："K/V separation HURTS by 0.3 PPL. This means your framework doesn't naturally handle the K/V asymmetry that RateQuant addresses. RateQuant supports asymmetric K/V allocation (K=2.85, V=2.15) which you listed as a differentiation point — but your own experiment shows separation is worse." R2："The fact that V heads are all assigned 4-bit under separation suggests V quantization sensitivity is uniform — but you don't analyze WHY, which is the interesting question." 在 worst 档下，K/V separation negative 被 reviewer 用来论证 framework 不够 flexible，且 RateQuant 在 K/V 处理上更优。

name: L0-only heuristic baseline
description: 最简 non-uniform 策略：L0 全 8-bit，其余 uniform 4-bit

tables.caption: L0 heuristic vs MCKP across architectures

analysis:
L0 heuristic 是 worst 档下 reviewer 手中的核武器：simple, zero-cost, gets most of the benefit。新 framing 必须 honest acknowledge 这一点，并将 MCKP 的 marginal benefit (Qwen: 11.52→10.91) 框定为 "the gap that motivates profiling when diagnostic recommends it"。


R3 (最致命)："Your L0 heuristic baseline gets PPL 11.52 (median) vs MCKP 10.91 — a gap of only 0.61 PPL. The L0 heuristic requires ZERO profiling (just assign 8-bit to Layer 0), while MCKP requires 65 minutes of GPU time. The marginal benefit of full profiling + MCKP over the trivial L0 heuristic is minimal. Practitioners should just protect Layer 0 and move on." R1 补充："On Llama, MCKP (8.45) barely beats the L0 heuristic (8.58 naive), and on Mistral, MCKP (7.16) is WORSE than uniform (7.13). The sophisticated optimization adds value only on Qwen, and even there the L0 heuristic gets 80% of the benefit for free." 在 worst 档下，L0 heuristic 被 reviewer 提升为 "the real practical recommendation"—— zero-cost, zero-profiling, captures most of the benefit on the one model where benefit exists。

name: Greedy + cardinality constraint ablation
description: RateQuant greedy + max_2bit=k=8 vs constrained MCKP
analysis:
这是 worst 档下 reviewer 最强的 single-line attack："Your contribution is k=8." 新 framing 不再将 solver equivalence 作为 surprising finding，而是将其框定为 "the constrained allocation problem is well-behaved" 的方法学观察——支撑 "practitioners need only add one parameter" 的实用结论。


R3："Greedy + constraint = MCKP + constraint (Δ=0.001). This PROVES that MCKP is not a contribution — the constraint alone is sufficient, and any solver (including the simplest greedy) achieves identical results. Your paper presents MCKP as a contribution but your own ablation shows it's irrelevant." R2："The solver equivalence is not 'surprising' as you claim — it's the expected consequence of a tight constraint that reduces the feasible set to near-singleton. When max_2bit=8 and budget=0.25, there are very few feasible allocations. Any reasonable solver will find the same one." R1："You've demonstrated that your contribution reduces to a single integer hyperparameter k. This is Appendix-level content, not a paper." 在 worst 档下，solver equivalence 从 "surprising finding that the constraint is the contribution" 翻转为 "proof that there is no contribution beyond a trivial hyperparameter"。

name: Multi-seed error bars
description: 3 个 calibration seed 的 MCKP PPL mean±std (Qwen2.5-7B)
analysis:
Multi-seed 在新 framing 下需要扩展：至少 5 seeds on Qwen，3 seeds on 每个额外模型。 10% allocation instability 需要 explicitly discuss 并说明为什么 PPL impact 是 minimal (std=0.065)。


R2："Three seeds is the bare minimum, not rigorous. Standard practice for quantization papers is 5-10 seeds with 95% CI. Your std=0.065 means 95% CI is roughly [10.86, 11.12] — the upper bound is 11.12, still well below uniform 15.45, so the Qwen result holds. But you don't provide multi-seed results for ANY other model. Without error bars on Llama (delta=+0.2%), Yi, Mistral, and Gemma-2, I cannot determine whether their marginal results are signal or noise." R1："Allocation agreement of 90.2% across 3 seeds means ~10% of heads are assigned differently depending on calibration data. This instability undermines the profiling-based approach — which 10% of heads get 2-bit vs 4-bit is random." R3："The 90% agreement is particularly concerning for deployment: practitioners can't rely on a specific allocation if it changes with calibration data." 在 worst 档下，multi-seed 结果暴露了两个 weakness：(1) n=3 seeds 不够，(2) allocation instability 10%。

name: Runtime/latency benchmark
description: 端到端推理延迟和吞吐量测量
analysis:
Runtime overhead 是新 framing 下必须直面的 weakness。MCKP 同压缩比下比 uniform 慢 8%， 这意味着 Qwen 的 +29% PPL improvement 伴随 8% latency cost。新 framing 应承认这一 tradeoff 并将 kernel optimization 列为 future work。对 7/8 无 PPL benefit 的模型， mixed-precision 的 latency overhead 是 pure cost——进一步支撑 "use diagnostic before profiling" 的实用建议。

R1 (最致命)："Mixed-precision MCKP is SLOWER than uniform 4-bit: 21.8 tok/s vs 23.6 tok/s (8% throughput loss), 46.1 ms vs 42.5 ms decode latency (8.5% overhead). You achieve the SAME memory compression (4×) with WORSE latency. For 7/8 models where MCKP doesn't improve PPL, this is a pure loss — worse latency for no quality benefit. Even on Qwen where PPL improves, practitioners must decide whether +29% PPL improvement justifies -8% throughput." R2："The uniform 4-bit itself is already 20% slower than bf16 — your method adds another 8% on top. The memory savings don't translate to speed because your mixed-precision dequantization kernel is not optimized." R3："The 0.005s solver time is irrelevant — the problem is inference-time overhead from heterogeneous bit-width lookup, which you don't address." 在 worst 档下，runtime 结果是 practical deployment value claim 的致命打击。
